## 🎨 UI/Component Rules
- Follow shadcn UI design principles.
- Follow shadcn UI conventions and component APIs.
- shadcn prebuilt components = automatic color adjustment + less manual designWhen creating a component, 
- Maintain consistent styling across all pages
